_readme: Hook configuration for myfriendroze (Astro web app). See .claude/hooks/README.md for full documentation.

custom_notes: Astro project root is astro/ — run build/dev commands from there
Firebase functions live in firebase/functions/ — Node 18 ESM
Deploy: cd astro && npm run build, then firebase deploy --only hosting
Products/events data: astro/src/data/ (edit here, not in Firebase directly during dev)
No SSR — this is a static site. API routes go in astro/src/pages/api/

branch_delete_guard._note: Blocks `git push <remote> --delete <branch>` when an open PR still bases off that branch (deleting a stacked PR's base auto-closes it instead of merging it, and a closed PR's base can't be retargeted — see myfriendroze#22/#23 incident, 2026-09-02). Fails open if gh CLI is unavailable/unauthenticated.

merge_guard._note: Unconditionally blocks `gh pr merge`, the `gh api .../pulls/{n}/merge` REST equivalent, a local `git merge` on master/main, and a push refspec that lands a branch directly on master/main. Merging must happen via Emily on the GitHub PR page after she explicitly says go-ahead in the conversation — this hook can't verify that from inside a Bash call, so it always blocks rather than trying. See myfriendroze#25 incident, 2026-09-02 (merged two PRs she'd asked for a fresh Copilot review pass on first).
